recipe_snapshot.source_note: Literal mapped OSM pit path with primaryGoogle andFIAcorroboration. Legacyframe sourcefit RMS~1–2m, maximum~7m atInterlagos, explicitphase+58m. Nativewholeloop/roadunchanged. Nominal6m drivablecorridor is estimated within sourcepavement, not surveyed fast-lane width. Endpointsregistered within retainedfituncertainty; native source/cooked gatesrequired.

plan_registration.imagery_epoch: Unknown; provider acquisition and watermark do not establish capture year.

protection_snapshot.source_note: Retained barrier geometry plus primary Google pit/road/garage relationship. New divider lies between unchanged Road+0.85m kerb and actual mapped pit paving; XY is estimated within this visible strip. Existing 0.95m concrete collision height and 0.15m radius retained. Native/source review required, especially joins to retained wall ends.

reconstruction.validation_limits: Sampled runtime PASS does not establish full driving, native mesh clearance, geometry fidelity or visual approval. Reconstructed ramp heights and divider positions retain their stated uncertainty.

legacy_registration.native_anchor_convention: Literal relation start is anchored exactly to the unchanged native road. Interlagos retains the fitted scale/rotation; its anchor differs by about 1m from the unconstrained least-squares intercept.
